hse_subtitle: Our commitment to health, safety, environment, and quality excellence
hse_health_para_1: At SIGAT, health and safety are embedded in every aspect of our operations. We are committed to providing a safe and healthy working environment for all employees, contractors, and stakeholders, guided by our comprehensive HSE management system aligned with ISO 45001 standards.
hse_health_para_2: Our safety culture is built on proactive hazard identification, rigorous risk assessment, and continuous improvement. All personnel undergo mandatory HSE induction training, task-specific toolbox talks, and regular emergency response drills. We maintain a strict incident reporting and investigation protocol to prevent recurrence.
hse_health_para_3: Key initiatives include a Behavior-Based Safety (BBS) program, monthly safety stand-downs, dedicated HSE officers on every project site, and a comprehensive Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) policy enforced across all work areas.
hse_quality_para_1: SIGAT operates a robust Quality Management System (QMS) certified to ISO 9001:2015. Our quality approach encompasses every phase of project delivery — from initial design and procurement through construction, testing, and handover.
hse_quality_para_2: We implement a rigorous quality control framework including material traceability, weld inspection and non-destructive testing (NDT), civil works testing (concrete compression, soil compaction, steel reinforcement), and systematic document control. Each project has a dedicated Quality Engineer who ensures compliance with project specifications, applicable standards, and client requirements.
hse_quality_para_3: Our commitment to quality is reflected in our supplier qualification program, regular internal audits, management reviews, and a closed-loop corrective action system that drives continuous improvement across all operations.
hse_certifications_text: SIGAT is proud to be fully certified under internationally recognized management system standards. These certifications demonstrate our unwavering commitment to quality, environmental stewardship, and occupational health and safety.

about_story_text: Founded in 2010, the International Society of Major Works (SIGAT) specializes in executing public works and hydraulic infrastructure projects. Based in Le Bardo, Tunisia, our team of highly qualified experts is committed to providing services that combine technical expertise with respect for environmental standards.
about_mission_text: To deliver precise execution of hydraulic and public works in Tunisia, strictly respecting deadlines, budgets, and the highest safety standards.
about_vision_text: To become the reference execution partner in Tunisia for major construction groups, recognized for our mastery of water and sanitation networks.
